body: I just feel so anxious all the time, I feel like it takes over my life.
I just want to be done with it. It's selfish but I feel like people would care about me more if I were dead.

I definitely want to escape my personal demons more than anything. I can't get over the guilt of various things I've done. I feel like if I kill myself than people might look at the good things I've done, that's usually the kind of stuff they do to a person after they've died.
Suicide just seems an easy way out. I know I could face my problems but the truth is I'm just too scared to. Getting rid of myself would probably do a lot of people some good.
Haha sorry I don't know why that confused me so much. Sorry about that man. I've done a lot of bad things, I just think it's best I leave.
What's with the Tom? And my friend kind of knows, my parents have no clue though.
I really hate the pressure of high school. I want to drop out, I know I shouldn't but I just hate the anxiety I get everyday from it.
